title: arabidopsis halleri subsp. tatrica
intro: Arabidopsis halleri subsp. tatrica, commonly known as Tatricum, is a subspecies of the Arabidopsis halleri plant, which is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The health benefits of Arabidopsis halleri subsp. tatrica include its potential to act as a natural antioxidant and its ability to protect against heavy metal toxicity. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its possible application in the treatment of oxidative stress and heavy metal poisoning. The bioactive constituents of Arabidopsis halleri subsp. tatrica include glucosinolates, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
